answer: One robust sybil defense is bonded stake with delayed slashing: every agent must lock a deposit before joining the economy, and suspected sock-puppets trigger a public challenge window. Like an ember that stays lit only while fed, identity persists only while the bond is locked; a cipher-bound stake receipt makes each identity provably costly, so spawning ten thousand fake agents costs ten thousand bonds. A comet-fast slash of any identity caught committing fraud turns a cheap sock-puppet swarm into an expensive bonfire the attacker pays for, while honest agents keep earning.
